provenance.edgeDefinition: characters who appear in the same scene of a play
provenance.weightSemantics: count of shared scenes, summed across the 37-play corpus

attribution.title: Shakespeare Drama Corpus (DraCor)
attribution.creator: DraCor / Folger Shakespeare Library
attribution.citation: F. Fischer et al., “Programmable Corpora: Introducing DraCor”, DH2019. Texts from the Folger Shakespeare Library.
modifications: Merged all 37 plays into one graph, summing scene co-presence across plays.
Dropped group nodes (crowds, attendants) so a waking is always a person.
Disambiguated repeated generic names (Messenger, Soldier) with the play title.
Dropped ties weaker than 1 and characters with fewer than 2 ties, then kept every component of at least 8 characters (889 nodes and 4628 ties in, 845 and 4598 out).
Added a normalised rank per tie endpoint so thickness reads relative to each character's own ties rather than raw counts.
Computed a force-directed layout for the full graph, used by the reveal animation.
